title: Construction in Jacó: Homes & Commercial | MA Soluciones
description: Construction company in Jacó with 300+ projects and 16 years in the Central Pacific. Homes, villas and commercial buildings with CFIA management and 48h quotes.
lead: We build homes, villas and commercial spaces in Jacó and nearby areas, with first-hand knowledge of the coastal climate: high humidity, heavy rain and salty air that demand solid details from the foundation to the roof.
heroAlt: Residential construction project in Jacó, Central Pacific Costa Rica
highlightsTitle: Building in Jacó requires local experience

highlights.title: Materials for coastal weather
highlights.text: We specify block, steel and finishes resistant to Pacific humidity and salinity, so the building ages well without surprise maintenance costs.

highlights.title: Permits and CFIA
highlights.text: We handle drawings, permits with the Municipality of Garabito and CFIA filings, so your project never stops over paperwork.

highlights.title: Updates for absent owners
highlights.text: Many Jacó projects belong to owners living abroad. We deliver photo and video progress reports at every stage, with a single point of contact.

zoneLinkText: Jacó is the tourist and residential hub of the Central Pacific, between Garabito, Herradura and Playa Hermosa. We serve the area from our local base.

faqs.q: How long does it take to build a house in Jacó?
faqs.a: A residential home usually takes 4 to 8 months depending on size and finishes. Before starting, we deliver a schedule with milestones and partial delivery dates.

faqs.q: Do you know Garabito building regulations?
faqs.a: Yes. We regularly work in Jacó and Garabito canton: we know the municipality requirements, local soils and CFIA rules for coastal projects.

faqs.q: Can you build if I am outside Costa Rica?
faqs.a: Yes. We coordinate the site locally and report progress with photos, videos and video calls. One point of contact centralizes decisions, purchases and payments.
